runSubtyping.Rd

TODO.

runSubtyping(geneLists, expectedCountsMatrix, permRatio = 0.75, permNbr = 20)

Arguments

geneLists

a list containing signature gene lists. At least two signature gene lists must be present.

expectedCountsMatrix

a normalized gene expression data matrix with rows corresponding to genes and columns to samples.

permRatio

a numeric between 0 and 1 representing the number of samples that are retained for the permutation step. The rounded value of the number of patients multiplied by this numeric should be inferior to the total number of patients so that the permutation step is not done on the entire cohort. Default: 0.75.

permNbr

a integer, 5 or higher, representing the number of permutation sampling done. In addition, the number of permutations must be equal or inferior to the total number of unique permutations with the dataset considering the parameters selected by the user. Default: 20.

Value

TRUE

Author

Astrid Deschênes

Examples


## Loading signatures
data("signatures")

## Load demo normalized expected counts for 30 patients
data("expNormalCountsDemo")

## Some of the enrichment results present in the dataset
## TODO
runSubtyping(geneLists=signatures, expectedCountsMatrix=expNormalCountsDemo, 
    permRatio=0.75, permNbr=20)
